name: onlyx-login
description: Sign in to OnlyFans for your OnlyX-managed account, on your own computer.
author: OnlyX <support@onlyx.ai>

scripts.test:e2e: node -e "require('electron')" && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/e2e/app.test.js test/e2e/no-tunnel.test.js test/e2e/diagnostics.test.js test/e2e/vendor-popup.test.js test/e2e/no-link.test.js test/e2e/branding.test.js test/e2e/layout.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker build -f test/e2e/Dockerfile -t onlyx-login-e2e . && docker run --rm --shm-size=1g onlyx-login-e2e
